title: Beer Money: brotherhood, betrayal & revenge
summary: Bobby Roode’s failed title challenge is followed by James Storm’s success. Roode chooses the championship over their friendship, leaving Storm to pursue revenge against his former partner.

chapters.title: Storm wins the title Roode could not
chapters.result: James Storm defeats Kurt Angle for the TNA world championship.
chapters.context: Storm’s sudden success comes directly after Roode’s Bound for Glory disappointment, putting a new strain on Beer Money’s partnership.

chapters.title: Roode uses Storm’s own beer bottle
chapters.result: Bobby Roode defeats Storm to win the TNA world championship.
chapters.context: Roode strikes his partner with the bottle and steals the title. The betrayal dissolves Beer Money and turns the championship pursuit into a personal vendetta.

chapters.title: Storm wins the grudge match
chapters.result: James Storm defeats Bobby Roode in a street fight.
chapters.context: With King Mo as special enforcer, Storm gains the revenge that matters beyond the championship: a decisive win over the partner who betrayed him.
